name: Argilla
description: Argilla is a collaboration tool for AI engineers and domain experts to build high-quality datasets. Teams annotate records in a web UI, collect human feedback on model outputs, and manage datasets through a Python SDK that integrates with the Hugging Face Hub.

notes.text: Sign in as admin with ADMIN_PASSWORD from /opt/argilla_data/.env. ADMIN_API_KEY there is the key for the Python SDK.

app_vars.name: var_argilla_password
app_vars.label: Admin Password
app_vars.help: At least 8 characters. Generated when left empty

app_vars.name: var_argilla_api_key
app_vars.label: Admin API Key
app_vars.help: At least 8 characters. Generated when left empty
